sinopsis.es: Lela y Vid son dos hermanos que crecen en un entorno familiar tóxico, lleno de violencia y carga emocional. Son aliados para lidiar con sus padres. Pero un incidente desencadena un conflicto entre ellos.
sinopsis.en: Lela and Vid are sister and brother growing up in a toxic family environment filled with violence and emotional weight. They are each other’s allies in dealing with their parents. But an incident leads to a conflict between them.
